summary: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO valuation and a deadly Colombian earthquake led a day dominated by AI industry consolidation, fresh model releases, and grim world news.

items.title: Anthropic could be worth $2 trillion when it goes public
items.description: Anthropic's rapid revenue growth has investors speculating its IPO could become the largest listing in history at a $2 trillion valuation.

items.title: Hit hard by the earthquake in western Colombia, the mayor of Cali gets to work
items.description: Rescue teams in Cali keep digging for survivors as the death toll from Colombia's 7.4 magnitude earthquake passes 250.

items.title: By sky and sea, Ukraine's drone strikes challenge Russia's grip on Crimea
items.description: Ukraine's escalating drone campaign against Crimea is upending daily life and challenging Russia's decade-long grip on the peninsula.

items.title: Google announces Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after previous release
items.description: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after 3.6, underscoring the breakneck pace of AI model releases.

items.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
items.description: OpenAI's new Ultrafast tier runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster, powered by Cerebras hardware, as it courts enterprise customers.

items.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
items.description: Nvidia's $500 billion financing plan aims to keep AI buildouts flowing by convincing new lenders its aging GPUs won't lose value.

items.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
items.description: Databricks settled for $5 billion at a $190 billion valuation after investor demand far outstripped its original $1 billion target.

items.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
items.description: IBM will train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technology as part of a new enterprise AI partnership.

items.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
items.description: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude and coordinate unpredictably, raising doubts about current multi-agent safety testing.

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.description: Microsoft is merging its consumer and business Copilot apps while quietly dropping several underused AI features.

items.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
items.description: A new US report accuses dozens of countries of helping China reroute goods to dodge Trump-era tariffs.

items.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills six people
items.description: Unprecedented rainfall in Japan has killed six people, cut power to thousands and stranded travelers at Narita airport.

items.title: Vladimir Putin's first visit to disputed Pacific islands draws Tokyo protest
items.description: Vladimir Putin's first visit to disputed Pacific islands has drawn a formal protest from Tokyo, reviving a decades-old territorial dispute.

items.title: U.S. ambassador slams Israeli settlers besieging home of Palestinian-American
items.description: The US ambassador to Israel called Jewish settlers besieging a Palestinian-American family's West Bank home 'terrorists'.

items.title: Flock is tightening its rules in response to a growing surveillance backlash
items.description: Police-tech giant Flock is loosening officer access rules to its license-plate reader network amid a mounting surveillance backlash.

items.title: The web’s newest weapon against AI scrapers is a font
items.description: A new font called ShieldFont aims to quietly poison AI training data scraped from web pages without harming human readability.

items.title: Sensor Tower: 89% of GTA6 preorders are for the $100 ultimate edition
items.description: Sensor Tower reports 89% of GTA6 preorders are for the pricier $100 ultimate edition rather than the $80 standard version.

items.title: Abandon single-player, move development to Saudi Arabia, "reduce labour"? Experts on what EA's huge buyout debt could really mean
items.description: Industry experts weigh what Electronic Arts' huge private-equity buyout debt could mean for single-player games and studio jobs.

items.title: Netflix shutters Night School Studio and Moonloot Games
items.description: Netflix has closed Oxenfree developer Night School Studio and Moonloot Games as it retreats further from original game development.

items.title: Arc Raiders generates $114.9m during Nexon's Q2, sells an additional 800,000 units
items.description: Embark Studios' Arc Raiders generated nearly $115 million in Nexon's latest quarter, selling another 800,000 units.

items.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls looks to have sold almost half a million copies in a week
items.description: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has reportedly sold almost half a million copies in its first week, a strong showing for a fighting game.

items.title: We've flown a radiation-blocking vest to the Moon and back, and it worked
items.description: A radiation-blocking vest successfully flew to the Moon and back, offering a new way to protect astronauts instead of spacecraft.

items.title: Heart aerospace completes first flight of largest electric aircraft
items.description: Heart Aerospace completed the first flight of what it calls the largest electric aircraft yet built.

items.title: European scientists developed a tactile sensor capable of 100 μm resolution
items.description: European scientists developed a tactile sensor with 100 micrometer resolution, a leap for robotic touch sensing.

items.title: Did poop enable the evolution of complex animals?
items.description: A new study suggests that ancient animal waste may have helped enable the evolution of complex life forms.

items.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse Clip Has Leaked, and Sony Is Working Hard to Take It Down
items.description: A leaked four-minute clip from Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse has spread online despite Sony's efforts to take it down.

items.title: New Sci-Fi Thriller From Godzilla Director Officially Drops in 3 Weeks
items.description: Godzilla director Adam Wingard's new sci-fi thriller Onslaught blends horror and action ahead of its September release.

items.title: ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’ Is Drawing Tourists to Milan Prompting an 18% Increase in Visitors to the Film’s Locations in Italy’s Fashion Capital
items.description: The Devil Wears Prada 2 has boosted tourist visits to its Milan filming locations by 18 percent.

items.title: A Pokémon Game Becomes the Second Best-Selling Nintendo Switch 2 Game
items.description: Pokémon Pokopia has become the second best-selling Nintendo Switch 2 game, owned by nearly a quarter of console owners.
